description: lib/string.fz's String.to_float splits on '.' and computes whole + fraction / pow10: no exponent ("1e3"), and the result is not correctly rounded. Elixir's String.to_float("1.0e3") is 1000.0 and every result is the nearest float. Expected: it reads through the same runtime helper Float.parse uses (fz-sc8.16), raising ArgumentError where Elixir does.
title: String.to_float parses exponents and rounds correctly, as in Elixir
